scope: One printed reference sheet plus one non-load-bearing card/paper ENV-D1 geometry gauge. No wearable test, powered system, sensors or full build.

before.state: The sheet specifies ENV-D1 geometry; no physical plate/gauge is evidenced by this receipt.
before.question: Are the plate, rail centerlines, corner and slot dimensions coherent enough to fabricate without hidden interpretation?

use: Print one A3 landscape copy as a reference sheet; written dimensions remain authoritative.
Make one scrap-card/paper 160 × 110 mm gauge and mark R10 corners.
Mark rail centerlines at y=30 mm and y=80 mm and verify 50 mm separation.
Mark the declared rail-slot geometry and lay two 25 mm-wide paper/webbing strips on the rail lines.
Do not wear, load, or treat the gauge as structural.
after: One labelled geometry gauge plus PASS / AMBIGUOUS / FAIL on whether the drawing is sufficient for the first real plate.
evidence: Photo of gauge beside the A3 sheet.
Ruler/caliper evidence of 160 × 110 mm outer dimensions.
Evidence of 50 mm separation between rail centerlines.
Close-up of one slot marking and one R10 corner marking.
One note listing any dimension that required guessing.
next: PASS → fabricate one real ENV-D1 plate and two rails for a bench-only dock geometry proof. AMBIGUOUS/FAIL → revise or annotate only the unclear geometry before cutting real material.
